bugs.summary: The result of field_transformer is used as-is. If the transformer returns a generator or other one-shot iterable, the order check consumes it, and the later steps (alias resolution, building the class) see an empty sequence.
bugs.trigger: A field_transformer written as a generator (yield f for f in fields) worked in 25.1.0; after this change the class ends up with no attributes (upstream fix wraps the result in tuple()).
